verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents its own secrets and configuration handling: a unified workflow for infrastructure, secrets and config, and centralized secrets. Pulumi ESC adds secrets management via CLI/SDK, OIDC-issued short-lived cloud tokens and automatic secrets rotation, which together support keeping credentials out of code. However, the evidence is mostly headline-level and never shows how secrets are kept out of logs or outputs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of secret masking in logs/outputs, documentation of encrypted secret config values in stack config/state, how-to depth on passing secrets into deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration
